idle_prompt: The person shown in the reference image stands upright in the same spot for the whole video, looking exactly as they appear in the reference image: same face, same hairstyle, same clothing, same body shape, and the same background behind them. The person's feet stay planted on the ground, shoulders level and relaxed, with only gentle natural breathing and no large or sudden movements. The face holds a calm, neutral, relaxed expression that never changes, lips closed at all times, no smile and no frown. The camera is locked in place and completely static, holding the same angle, distance and framing throughout, and the background stays exactly consistent with the reference image. Stable, smooth, high quality video.
greet_prompt: The person shown in the reference image stands upright in the same spot for the whole video, looking exactly as they appear in the reference image: same face, same hairstyle, same clothing, same body shape, and the same background behind them. The person gives a natural, friendly wave hello: raises one arm, waves the hand, then lowers it again. Everything else stays steady while waving: feet planted on the ground without stepping, torso facing forward without twisting, shoulders level, head still. The face keeps a calm, neutral, relaxed expression with lips closed, no exaggerated smile. The camera is locked in place and completely static, holding the same angle, distance and framing throughout, and the background stays exactly consistent with the reference image. Stable, smooth, high quality video.
_comment: 2026-10-28 身份修复：原提示词把外观/场景写死为鬼子男青年（黑衣眼镜/夜景街道），SCAIL-2 文本权重压过节点30参考图，换任何照片生成结果仍是鬼子——已实锤（node30.image=新照片，输出仍是男青年）。修复原则：身份/服装/背景一律指代参考图（'The person shown in the reference image...'），文本只写动作/镜头/稳定性/表情锁定。force_rate/fps 不动；SCAIL cfg 保持 1.0（scail.py 节点19，蒸馏 LoRA 下高 cfg 烧画面）、replacement_mode 保持 false（true 会出两张脸），不在本配方动。
